title: Gintama: THE VERY FINAL
summary: The third and last Gintama film (銀魂 THE FINAL, Warner Bros. Japan / BN Pictures, 2021-01-08, 104 min): the animation of Sorachi's manga ending. Three independent sources give the same span in the printed Lesson numbering: the Gintama Wiki's film page ('adapting the remainder of the Silver Soul Arc from Lesson 699 - Lesson 704 along with new material'), ja-Wikipedia ('ストーリーはジャンプGIGAおよび銀魂公式アプリ掲載分をベースにし' — and the same article's own serialization record makes that stretch exactly 699-704: Jump GIGA 2019 WINTER vol.1-3 = 699/700/701, the 銀魂公式アプリ updates 2019-05-13 → 06-20 = 702/703/704, after WSJ closed on 698 in 2018 #42), and MangaUpdates' per-work coverage segment 'Vol 77, Chap 704 (The Final Movie)'. The fandom's per-chapter reverse index agrees from the other direction: every one of Lessons 699-704 carries episode=[[Gintama THE FINAL]] and vol=77, and nothing below 699 does. The film's plot record maps 1:1 onto the six chapter titles in order — 699 坂田銀時と仲間たち (the Terminal assault), 700 鋼の心臓 (Katsura vs Hitsugi, Shouyou's heart destroyed), 701 ホーミング本能 (Sadaharu's recovery, the Yorozuya reunion), 702 宿命 (Takasugi and the revived Shouyou), 703 右目 (Utsuro's death and Takasugi's, the left-eye/right-eye farewell), 704 天然パーマにロクな奴はいない (Shouyou's sacrifice, Tama in future Tokyo, the sham ending, the Yorozuya running off to a job they have forgotten). Non-source material is framing, not story: a roughly ten-minute 'previously on' prologue staged as a Dragon Ball parody (ANN's review: 'The first ten or so minutes is a recap but done almost entirely as a Dragon Ball parody, complete with character redesigns and turning manga pages'; ja-WP lists CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA as an insert song; the official site sells it as the newcomer on-ramp, 「これまでの物語がまるっと分かる超安心の親切設計」), and a post-credit 3年Z組銀八先生 gag short in which Sorachi is lampooned by his own characters. Under T28's recap clause the prologue is weightless and the remainder — a faithful, abridged adaptation of 289 manga pages in ~90 minutes — decides the standing: canon. Surprise for the file: our episode rows 368 and 369 ARE Gintama: THE SEMI-FINAL (the dTV special, 2021-01-15 / 01-20), which the licensor calls the film's 前日譚 and which adapts Lessons 687-698 — the chapters that did not fit in the movie — so the air-date-derived position 367.5 puts the film a fortnight of story BEFORE the episodes it continues.

chapters_adapted.note: Lessons 699-704 — the whole Jump GIGA + official-app 完結編, i.e. the back half of the final tankōbon (vol 77 = 696-704 per en-WP's volume list and the fandom's 'Lessons and Volumes'; the film opens at 699, three chapters into the book). 289 pages by the fandom's own page counts (699: 53, 700: 53, 701: 47, 702: 30, 703: 47, 704: 59) in a 104-minute film, so ABRIDGED throughout: director Chizuru Miyawaki told Cinema Today / Mynavi the base chapters were 「プロットにするまでもなく普通に考えたら入らないだろうというくらいの尺」 and that she rebuilt them around the Shōka Sonjuku trio (Gintoki / Katsura / Takasugi) rather than the Yorozuya, to avoid re-treading the 2013 完結篇. Cuts, reorders and expansions of the source's own events (all flashbacks redrawn — ja-WP 「回想シーンが全て描き直されている」; an added treatment of Takasugi's eye 「原作にない高杉の目の表現」; a small staging change in the epilogue's Okita/Kagura beat) are faithfulness-clause divergences, not original material — the post-release comparison at club-typhoon.com reads 「原作の77巻、つまり最終巻の『ジャンプGIGAに移ってからの物語』をほとんどそのまま再現しています」「セリフだけでなくアングルや構図に至るまで本当に忠実に再現した」. Ch 704 is adapted through its last beat — the sham ending is broken, Tamako's false memories shatter and the Yorozuya rush off to an urgent job they have already forgotten — which is also MangaUpdates' pin ('Vol 77, Chap 704 (The Final Movie)'; MU's convention names the last chapter adapted IN FULL). weight: significant — this is the whole job of the work; nothing else in the film progresses the story.

position.why: CORRECTED to 369.5 — after our last row. Rows 368 (2021-01-15) and 369 (2021-01-20) are the two Gintama: THE SEMI-FINAL episodes (万事屋篇 / 真選組篇), already in our grid with anchors 687-698, and they precede the film in STORY order even though they streamed a week after its theatrical release. Four sources: (1) the Gintama Wiki's film infobox prints previous = [[Episode 369]] (Chronological); (2) its Episode 368 / 369 pages both say 'a prequel to Gintama THE FINAL, adapting the chapters that were not able to make it into the movie'; (3) ja-WP 銀魂 THE FINAL: 「本作品の前日譚として『銀魂 THE SEMI-FINAL』が同年1月15日よりdTVにて独占配信」, covering 「第76巻六百八十七訓後半から第77巻第六百九十八訓中盤まで」; (4) en-WP: the special 'bridges the gap between the end of the TV anime and the movie'. The chapters settle it on their own — 687-698 (rows 368/369) run before 699-704 (the film). 367.5 was the air-date proposal and would make a viewer watch the ending before its set-up. The film's START is contiguous: our stored continue after row 369 is 699 and the film opens on 699.

flags_for_sean: POSITION MOVED PAST TWO ROWS THAT ARE THEMSELVES THE PREQUEL SPECIAL. Our episode rows 368 and 369 are Gintama: THE SEMI-FINAL, the dTV two-parter (万事屋篇 2021-01-15 / 真選組篇 2021-01-20; the stored titles and dates match ja-WP's episode table verbatim). They adapt Lessons 687-698 — explicitly 'the chapters that were not able to make it into the movie' (fandom) — and the licensor frames the special as the film's 前日譚. So the film belongs at 369.5, not 367.5. Note that ja-WP does NOT number the SEMI-FINAL episodes (its table heads them 万事屋篇 / 真選組篇 with no 話数); the fandom's 368/369 numbering is what our grid follows.

DUPLICATE RISK ON THE NEXT TARGET. The halo's PREQUEL relation 'Gintama: THE SEMI-FINAL' (the task gives AniList 121097 — UNVERIFIED here: the AniList API returned 403 'temporarily disabled' throughout this task, and anilist.co serves a JS shell, so I did not confirm the id) is ALREADY in the catalog as episode rows 368-369 WITH anchors. Ruling it as a related work would double-count the same two episodes. Recommend the SEMI-FINAL be dispositioned as 'already in the grid' rather than minted as a ledger row; if a row is wanted for discoverability it must carry no chapters of its own.

A NEVER-ADAPTED CHAPTER SITS JUST BELOW THIS FILM: Lesson 691 「まっしろ」 (vol 76, 18 pp). It is absent from the fandom's chapter fields for BOTH SEMI-FINAL episodes (368 = 687, 688, 689, 690, 692, 697, 698; 369 = 693, 694, 695, 696), absent from our stored chapters_adapted for those rows, has no episode= field on its own chapter page, and no episode page backlinks it (backlinks = Lesson 690, Lesson 692, Lessons and Volumes, Story Arcs only). The film does not cover it (699-704). Silence is not proof, but three independent readings point the same way — worth confirming when the SEMI-FINAL is researched. (Separately, ch 487 is a documented never-adapted chapter run-wide: ja-WP 「第四百八十七訓はアニメ化されなかった」, MU 'Skipped Chap 487'.)

ADJACENT ROW, OUTSIDE MY ASK: ep 367's END may be one partial short. ja-WP 銀魂 (アニメ) says the TV run animated 「第70巻の六百三十二訓から第76巻の第六百八十七訓の前半部分まで」 and that the SEMI-FINAL resumes at 「第六百八十七訓の後半」 — i.e. the first half of ch 687 aired in ep 367, whose stored anchor is 686-686 (the fandom's ep-367 field also says only Lesson 686). A 'first half' is not an A47 sliver, so if it holds, ep 367's END advances to 687 with a partial and row 368 starts inside 687. One source family only; flagged, not ruled.

JA-WP CONTRADICTS ITSELF ON WHERE THE SEMI-FINAL STOPS: the film article says 「第77巻第六百九十八訓中盤まで」, the anime article says 「第七十七巻の第六百九十六訓中盤まで」. The fandom's per-episode fields (368 carries 697 and 698) and our stored anchors support 698. Either way it stops short of 699, so this film's START is contiguous and unaffected.

THE POST-CREDIT SHORT IS NOT MANGA. The film closes with a 3年Z組銀八先生 segment in which Ginpachi interprets for a gorilla voiced by Sorachi himself, answering loose ends (is Gintoki half-Amanto? is the baby Takasugi?). ANN's review and the club-typhoon comparison both record it; the fandom's Bonus Segments page adds — SINGLE SOURCE — that it is 'based on the last pages of the Koujien Fanbook' (『銀魂公式ガイドブック 広辞漢』, a licensed guidebook, not the instrument's chapter space). It is a post-credit gag, not the row's substance, so I propose no side_source ruling; recorded here in case you want it as a note on the canon row.

THE ~10-MINUTE PROLOGUE IS A RECAP AND EARNS NO COVERAGE. It retells the story so far — including the 687-698 stretch our rows 368/369 adapt (the ウハル blog names exactly the beats it narrates: the Yorozuya's two years, Kondo's gorilla wedding, why Kuyō fell on the Terminal) — as a Dragon Ball parody with redesigns, turning manga pages and CHA-LA HEAD-CHA-LA. Warner released its first 90 seconds as an official 冒頭90秒映像 and the official site sells the design as the newcomer on-ramp. Per the recap clause it is weightless and per the haikyu precedent restaged/re-told material is deliberately kept OUT of chapters_adapted; if it were ever counted, it would be recap{687-698}, never coverage.

TASK PREMISE CORRECTED IN THREE PLACES: (a) the 最終話 is Lesson 704 「天然パーマにロクな奴はいない」 — a callback to ch 1's 「天然パーマに悪い奴はいない」 — not 「魂の器」; no chapter of that title exists in vol 77 (en-WP's volume list and the fandom's index agree on all nine titles). (b) Vol 77 is ch 696-704, not 699-704 — the film opens three chapters into the final book; the END row's volume is 77 either way. (c) gintama-movie.com does not resolve; the licensor site is wwws.warnerbros.co.jp/gintamamovie (live, and snapshotted 2021-01-11 in the Wayback Machine) — its /intro_story/ page is the one carrying 「原作のラストをベースにしたストーリー」.

COVERAGE CONSEQUENCE: this film closes the manga. Our run's furthest adapted chapter is 698 (row 368) and the last row's END is 696 with continue 699; the film carries a viewer to 704, the last chapter Sorachi drew. With it watched there is nothing left to read — gintama becomes a fully adapted series apart from the two holes above (691 and 487). Any post-series continue computed from episode rows alone under-reports it by the entire GIGA/app finale.

AUTHOR CREDIT, NOT ADOPTION (T26): Sorachi is credited 原作／ストーリー・キャラクター原案 on the film, drew four cuts as 原画 and voiced himself in the post-credit short (ja-WP, citing Natalie 2020-12-14 and MANTANWEB). That is a credit on a work that ADAPTS the finished manga — no material moves into the source line — so adopted stays null.
